name: Clusters — in-cluster mergers
sub: binaries that merge before they are ejected
mechanism: With post-Newtonian terms in the few-body dynamics, a comparable number of cluster binaries merge inside the cluster between encounters, before any recoil can eject them. Their last encounter left them with a higher eccentricity than the ejected population.
prediction: The middle peak of the cluster distribution, e₁₀Hz ~ 10⁻⁵–10⁻² — the orange histogram of Rodriguez+ 2018, Fig. 1 and the 'in-cluster' population of Zevin+ 2019, Fig. 6 (left) — still below what LVK can resolve today, but a target for ET/CE and for LISA, where these systems are visibly eccentric.

sources.label: Samsing & Ramirez-Ruiz 2017 — assembly rate of eccentric mergers

figure.caption: Zevin+ 2019, Fig. 6: eccentricity distributions (left) and delay times (right) for ejected, in-cluster and GW-capture inspirals from binary–binary encounters; horizontal lines mark the LISA and LIGO bands.
